title: Find It
story: The maze garden hides a gate number in a long list. Search it yourself, without shortcuts.
goal: Write find_index(items, target) returning the position of the first match, or -1. Do not use .index().
hints: Walk the list from the start and compare each item.
socratic: What should you return when you reach the end?
Which loop gives you the position and the value?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Find It”?
